<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" xmlns:inkscape="http://www.inkscape.org/namespaces/inkscape" viewBox="0 0 100 100">
  <title>Dropped</title>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="shade" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#f0a0c8"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#8cc8f0"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="50" fill="url(#shade)" inkscape:label="dropped"/>
</svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="100" height="100">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="shade" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#b69cff"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#7a5cf0"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <rect x="10" y="10" width="80" height="80" style="fill:url(#shade)"/>
</svg>
